Hi Aisha / Sam —

Thanks — I pushed a first-pass MAP and evaluation matrix to you both (attached). Key points up-front so you don't need to open the sheet:

- Recommendation: Run a 3-week PoC on Dedicated (EU region) with a parallel short Hosted smoke test for latency comparisons. Dedicated gives you predictable throughput for inference workloads and isolates behaviour for acceptance tests; Hosted is useful for validating peak tail-latency without infra setup.
- Migration path: Dedicated -> Private is supported; we can export config and KV caching profiles. Moving earlier (during PoC week 3) incurs a short revalidation window (1–2 days).
- Acceptance criteria (sample): 95th p90 latency < 220ms for 2K concurrent user simulations, embedding throughput >= X/min, and under 12% quality delta vs baseline prompts.
- Close timeline: target commercial signature 2026-11-20. Ops/legal gating items listed in the MAP tab.

Attachments: 2026-10-29_MAP-draft.xlsx (MAP + eval matrix), eval-matrix-v3.pdf (printable summary)

Action items:
1) Rishi: please confirm Dedicated EU instance sizing & estimated cost delta vs Hosted (ballpark numbers) by 10/30.
2) Laura: loop in procurement/legal for SOW redline template; we want initial terms by 11/03.
3) Aisha: share any non-negotiable compliance items (retention, specific KMS requirements) by 10/30 so we bake them into the PoC.

I'll stand up a short weekly sync cadence; propose Tuesdays 10am CET.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference

Mina / team — quick internal note and numbers for Aisha: \n
- Dedicated EU sizing: 4x A100-equivalent GPUs (shared across pooled jobs), estimated baseline commit monthly cost ~ $65k/mo.
- Hosted comparison: for the same throughput and 95th-percentile latency targets, Hosted run-rate is ~ $82k/mo (higher unit cost due to multi-tenant premium), but zero infra setup and faster time to validate.
- Private on-prem: one-time onboarding/packaging estimate ~ $220k (eng + packaging) + ongoing infra ops; move window 2–4 business days for config flip and routing.

I'll attach a short calc in the MAP spreadsheet. For the PoC, Dedicated gives clearer signal for SLA-based acceptance and reduces noise from noisy tenants. Hosted useful as a secondary smoke channel to validate public ingress latency.

Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pathfinder MAP — follow-ups and compliance notes

Thanks — this is helpful. A couple of clarifying points from our security/compliance team attached as a short list (see inline below):

- KMS: must support AWS KMS cross-account key wrapping and audit logs forwarded to our SIEM.
- Data residency: EU-only for PII; pseudo-anonymized telemetry may be allowed to cross-region.
- SOC2 evidence: we need a SOC2 Type II report or in-progress attestation artifacts.

Two asks for the MAP: can you add a fallback policy in week 2 if Dedicated performance is degraded (auto-fallback to Hosted for critical endpoints)? Also: can you provide a short template SOW (even redline stub) so procurement can start parallel review?

If we can get these items in the MAP and a committed PoC start date the week of 11/8, we can be on-track to the 11/20 signature.

Thanks,
Aisha
